usedFor: flowyteam tracks key results, and Asana receives a project through “Create Project” when one goes off track.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A key result going off track gets its own Asana project, so someone owns the fix.

watchOut: Each run of “Create Project” adds a new project, so check the owner and dates you set.
